title: A named persona/behavior-profile bundle
description: The document clozn.profiles.store.ProfileStore persists at ~/.clozn/profiles/<name>.json (clozn/profiles/store.py). This IS the artifact agent_roadmap/08-reversible-behavior-fixes.md's spec calls a 'behavior profile': `dials` is the control-vector half, `response_policies` is the prompt-policy half (each entry a clozn.replay.corrective.CORRECTION_PRESETS key). Deliberately retrofitted onto the EXISTING bundle rather than standing up a second, parallel store -- corrective_retries.py already mutates and transactionally undoes the response_policies half of this exact document (clozn/behavior/corrective_retries.py). `cards`/`custom_dials`/`facts` are carried, never applied (memory cards were cut from the product 2026-07-27); they stay in the schema only so an older bundle's export/import round-trip stays lossless. Only container SHAPES are asserted here (object vs array, dial values numeric), matching exactly what clozn.profiles.store.validate() already guarantees on every path that reaches this schema -- retrofitting adds a machine-checkable contract, not a new behavioral constraint, so a legitimately hand-edited bundle that already passed validate() must never fail this schema.

name.description: Slug-safe bundle name; also the filename stem.

dials.description: Control-vector dial settings applied on profile switch (clozn.profiles.store.apply_dials).

response_policies.description: Prompt-policy corrective presets active for this profile -- each entry a clozn.replay.corrective.CORRECTION_PRESETS key.

custom_dials.description: Recompilable custom-dial recipes (pole descriptions), carried verbatim.

facts.description: Slot-store fact sources, carried verbatim (recompiled on profile switch).

cards.description: Carried, never applied -- memory cards were cut from the product 2026-07-27.
